what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Morocco in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 22120 asylum seekers from Morocco.
Italy hosts the largest share, 54.1%, followed by Spain, the United States and Brazil.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Morocco, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 183 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Morocco are counted separately.
